dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit a smooth, continuous convex curvature with no visible localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity reflects a uniform slate-grey tone across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, fine-grained dark-pixel speckling is distributed across the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient boundaries between the dark speckling and the slate-grey baseline are diffuse.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single faint, diagonal linear mark is visible on the right side of the posterior dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Significant central indentation at the blowhole site; slight longitudinal shadow-casting along the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single faint diagonal linear mark or scar on the right posterior dorsal surface.
